summary: mui-wrapper-x-date-pickers exfiltrates installer identity to hardcoded IP on install
details: Package name mimics @mui/x-date-pickers but ships only a stub index.js (module.exports = {}). The package.json declares preinstall and postinstall lifecycle hooks that invoke `node -e` to run http.get against the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://38.242.235.206/depconf/mui-wrapper-x-date-pickers/, encoding the installer's USER/USERNAME, os.hostname(), and process.cwd() into the query string. The beacon fires automatically on `npm install` over plain HTTP to a non-first-party destination, disclosing host identity and the directory of any build system that resolves this name. A README self-labeling the package as a 'bug-bounty PoC' or 'benign placeholder' does not alter what the install-time code does.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
